headline: Sun Pharma issues notice for shareholders meeting via postal ballot in October 2026
hook: Upcoming postal ballot for Sun Pharma holders
summary: Sun Pharma has issued a notice for a postal ballot scheduled for October 2026. Shareholders will vote on upcoming corporate resolutions through this remote voting process. The filing is a routine corporate procedure for the listed pharmaceutical major. Retail investors holding the stock will need to participate in the voting as per the company schedule.
why_it_matters: Routine voting process for existing shareholders.

headline: Sun Pharma showcases two-year data for deuruxolitinib in alopecia areata
hook: Two-year trial data for new drug presented
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries released two-year clinical data for LEQSELVI (deuruxolitinib) at the EADV Congress 2026, demonstrating sustained efficacy and safety in treating severe alopecia areata. The findings highlight ongoing clinical development for the company's specialty dermatology portfolio. For Indian retail investors, pipeline updates from major pharmaceutical players dictate long-term global revenue diversification and R&D return expectations.
why_it_matters: Global specialty drug pipeline updates shape Sun Pharma's long-term revenue.

headline: Indian stock markets surrender recovery gains due to sustained FII selling
hook: Foreign institutional outflows pressure Indian benchmark indices
summary: Indian benchmark indices gave up intraday recovery attempts as relentless foreign institutional investor (FII) selling weighed on market sentiment. Sun Pharma emerged as the top drag among major constituents, leading losses across sectoral benchmarks. Persistent capital outflows continue to cap upside momentum in domestic equities. Retail investors should note that persistent FII selling often triggers broader market volatility and near-term weakness in large-cap stocks.
whats_next: Daily FII and DII trading activity data releases
why_it_matters: Persistent foreign outflows increase short-term volatility for domestic equity portfolios
winners_losers: Domestic institutional buyers gain / equity investors hurt
